fullPassage: You hear again and again that some of the greatest composers were misunderstood in their own day. Not everyone could understand the compositions of Beethoven, Brahms, or Stravinsky in their day. The reason for this initial lack of acceptance is unfamiliarity. The musical forms, or ideas expressed within them, were completely new. And yet, this is exactly one of the things that makes them so great. Effective composers have their own ideas. Have you ever seen the classic movie Amadeus? The composer Antonio Salieri is the "host" of this movie; he's depicted as one of the most famous non-great composers — he lived at the time of Mozart and was completely overshadowed by him. Now, Salieri wasn't a bad composer; in fact, he was a very good one. But he wasn't one of the world's great composers because his work wasn't original. What he wrote sounded just like what everyone else was composing at the time.

① 위대함을 만드는 독창성 — 글 전체 주제 <- 정답
② 고전 영화의 영향 — Amadeus는 예시일 뿐
③ 작곡가의 생애/사망 — 본문 주제 아님
④ 연습 방법 — 본문에 없음

ch: 고전 영화가 음악 감상에 미친 영향
작곡 실력을 키우는 효과적인 연습 방법

questions.passage: You hear again and again that some of the greatest composers were misunderstood in their own day. Not everyone could understand the compositions of Beethoven, Brahms, or Stravinsky in their day. The reason for this initial lack of acceptance is unfamiliarity. The musical forms, or ideas expressed within them, were completely new. And yet, this is exactly one of the things that makes them so great. Effective composers have their own ideas. Have you ever seen the classic movie Amadeus? The composer Antonio Salieri is the "host" of this movie; he's depicted as one of the most famous non-great composers — he lived at the time of Mozart and was completely overshadowed by him. Now, Salieri wasn't a bad composer; in fact, he was a very good one. But he wasn't one of the world's great composers because his work wasn't original. What he wrote sounded just like what everyone else was composing at the time.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 요지 ② — 독창적 아이디어가 위대함의 핵심
det.analysis:
① 익숙할수록 위대 — 초기엔 생소해서 오해받음(반대)
② 위대한 작곡가는 자신만의 독창적 아이디어를 지님 — 핵심 요지 <- 정답
③ 당대 인정이 유일 기준 — 위대한 작곡가는 당대에 오해받기도 함(반대)
④ 기술이 독창성보다 중요 — Salieri 예시와 반대

ch: 위대한 작곡가는 남과 다른 자신만의 독창적인 아이디어를 지닌다.
당대에 인정받는 것이 위대함의 유일한 기준이다.
뛰어난 작곡 기술이 독창성보다 더 중요하다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 표현을 조건에 맞게 영어로 쓰시오.
"그 음악 형식, 즉 그것들 안에 표현된 아이디어는 완전히 새로웠다."
The musical forms, or __________, were completely new.
[조건] (1) expressed, ideas, them, within을 모두 사용할 것 (2) 4단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: ideas expressed within them (그것들 안에 표현된 아이디어)
det.analysis:
'ideas(명사) + expressed within them(과거분사구 후치수식)' 구조.
본문 'the musical forms, or ideas expressed within them, were completely new'.
